【原视频简介】
Can yeast and sugar really help cucumber plants grow stronger and produce a bigger harvest? 🌱



In this video, I’m testing a simple homemade yeast and sugar mixture on my cucumber plants for 14 days to see what happens.



I’ll show you exactly how I prepare the mixture, dilute it, apply it around the root zone, and monitor the plants throughout the experiment.



This is a simple gardening experiment, not a miracle fertilizer. I want to find out whether a yeast-based mixture can support healthy cucumber growth and contribute to better plant development.



If you enjoy simple, natural gardening experiments, subscribe to Wonderful Garden No.1 for more practical plant-growing tests.



Have you ever used yeast for your plants? 🌱

Share your experience in the comments!



Thanks for watching, and happy gardening! 🌿
